snippet.title: Single-Stroke Path + Optical illusion | Opening Plot Animation | Mystery game "Cosmolace" PV
snippet.description:
A plot oriented puzzle game that combines "optical illusion" with "single stroke path" as its theme. Players use optical illusions by rotating their perspective in three-dimensional space to complete the graphics in the level with just single stroke.
Steam store page is now visible! Click to add to wishlist! (or search for the game name directly)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413210/_Cosmolace/

"In lightless depths, all begins to sprout"
"Thou art the Weaver, master of sight's wonder"
"Turning chaos to order, granting stars their voice"
"With faith as thy needle, wisdom thy thread"
"Points entwine, destiny heeds thy call"
"An endless weave, writing untold tales"
"Threads of light span paths across the land"
"In the abyss, echoes stir—fate begins to dance"
"Yet as light wanes, shadows softly creep"
"In the deep, whispers linger of life and death"
"They guide thy hand, unveiling the unknown"
